title: Party Mimosa
license_scope: Site-wide dedication covers text and images; no per-recipe license stated.
ingredients_source_markdown:
- 1 (12 ounce) can apricot-mango nectar
- 1 (12 ounce) can pineapple juice
- 1 (6 ounce) can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed and undiluted
- 1 (750 milliliter) bottle cold champagne
- 3/4 cup cold water
directions_source_markdown: 1. Stir together apricot nectar, pineapple juice, water, and orange juice concentrate in a large pitcher until combined. Pour in bottle of sparkling wine just before serving.
